name: Component Library Quality
description: Rules for shared component libraries and design-system packages that must stay composable, consistent, and accessible by default.

rules.instruction: Keep component APIs predictable and composable; document variants, defaults, keyboard behavior, and controlled/uncontrolled usage.
Keep colors, spacing, radii, type, and motion in shared tokens; do not hardcode one-off values inside primitives.
Make accessibility behavior part of the primitive default, including names, focus management, keyboard controls, and reduced motion.
